Slug.description: A letter-first kebab-case slug of at most 64 characters: lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens, starting with a letter (the kernel's IdentifierGrammar, as skill.schema.json pins it).
Slug.title: Slug

TextList.description: At least one non-blank string, in authored order.
TextList.title: TextList

AppliesTo.description: Where the context applies (ADR-0049 decision 14: advisory; nothing filters by it). Each list holds at least one entry when present.
AppliesTo.title: AppliesTo

Term.description: One term of a glossary context (ADR-0049 decision 3): an item of the context, not an artifact of its own, addressed term:<context-id>/<term-id>. Its id is unique within the context; JSON Schema cannot express that, so it is the domain's invariant.

id.description: The term's id, unique within its context.

avoid.description: Forms not to use: the one source of banned vocabulary (ADR-0049 decisions 5 and 15).

see_also.description: Related terms, each a term:<context-id>/<term-id> URN. One that no held context resolves is a broken reference.
see_also.title: See Also

Term.title: Term

description:
A glossary context (ADR-0049 decisions 1 to 6, ADR-0053 decisions 11 to 14): a ubiquitous-language bounded context with its terms, one per file at glossaries/<id>.glossary.yaml. The artifact kind is glossary; the context's URN is glossary_context:<id> and a term's is term:<context-id>/<term-id>. Closed at every level.

The id equals the file stem, and term ids are unique within the context; JSON Schema cannot express either, so both are the domain's invariants.

id.description: The context's id: its file stem.

description.description: The context's applicability, Contextive's domain vision statement.

tags.description: Tags, at least one, without duplicates.
tags.title: Tags

terms.description: The terms, in authored order; at least one.
terms.title: Terms

title: Glossary context
